monroe.note: Even she, who scolds everyone, has never once found a fault in Marilyn.

musk.note: Rockets and a pile of money, and she wants to know what he has actually done about it.

putin.note: A war and a pipeline, and he has never once answered for either.

queen.note: A lifetime of palaces and not a word about the planet.

thatcher.note: The coal and the free market, whatever she once said about the climate.

tyson.note: A gentle man with birds; she has nothing to scold him for.

zelensky.note: He stands up to the powerful, which is more than most grown-ups do.

greta.note: Brave, and not afraid to be disliked for it.

musk.note: Clever and amusing, if a little too pleased with himself.

putin.note: He looks through a person, and she has had enough of that.

queen.note: She has the calm that no amount of lighting can give.

thatcher.note: A woman who got into the room by sheer will; she respects that.

trump.note: He rates women out of ten and expects her to be pleased.

tyson.note: Gentle underneath, and kind to her without wanting anything.

zelensky.note: A fellow entertainer who walked onto a far bigger stage.

greta.note: Hardly an engineer, and rather too sure of her sermons.

monroe.note: The one person in the room he does not try to out-talk.

putin.note: A man whose phone calls everyone is curious about.

queen.note: Very old money, very quiet; he cannot tell what she thinks.

thatcher.note: She wrecked a few bureaucracies; he approves.

tyson.note: A man who can actually take a punch, which a founder respects.

zelensky.note: His satellites keep Zelensky's army online, and neither forgets it.

greta.note: A schoolgirl shouting at adults, and he has no time for it.

monroe.note: A star of the old kind, whom he watches with a faint smile.

musk.note: A useful man with a loud mouth, to be listened to carefully.

queen.note: The last of the old order, and he respects an order that lasts.

thatcher.note: The Iron Lady of the old Cold War, and he has not forgotten whose side she was on.

trump.note: A man he flatters and means to use, and thinks he has read.

tyson.note: A fighter, and the only sort of man he fully respects.

zelensky.note: The man his war is against, whom he will not name without contempt.

greta.note: Quite a determined young person; she says nothing.

monroe.note: The film star she once met in a line and has not forgotten.

musk.note: New money, new ideas and a great deal of noise.

putin.note: She has seen many rulers come and go, and he is not one she warms to.

thatcher.note: A most capable woman, and an awkward audience on Tuesdays.

trump.note: Polite company is a skill, and he lacks it.

tyson.note: A gentleman, which one does not always expect of a boxer.

zelensky.note: A leader who stayed in his capital when it counted.

greta.note: A young woman with a passion and not a single costed plan.

monroe.note: Charming, no doubt, and not in the least her business.

putin.note: A strongman who understands only strength, and she has spent her life answering that.

queen.note: Her Majesty, and she curtseys properly, whatever is said of her.

trump.note: A salesman who has never read a brief in his life.

tyson.note: A disciplined man for all the noise made about him.

zelensky.note: He stands against tyranny, and she would stand beside him.

monroe.note: Glamour like that, and she is not even trying; it is tremendous.

putin.note: Strong, smart, and a man he can talk to; people say so.

queen.note: The classiest woman in the world, and he likes to say so.

thatcher.note: A politician, and he has never met one who was a patch on him.

tyson.note: A real champion and a real friend, who knows what winning is.

zelensky.note: A politician who always arrives asking for something.

greta.note: A fierce kid, and he likes a person who does not back down.

monroe.note: Nobody has ever been so kind to him for no reason.

musk.note: A rich man with big ideas; he waits to see what comes of them.

putin.note: A man who has never lost a fight he picked; he keeps his distance.

queen.note: A lady, and he stands up straight in front of one.

thatcher.note: A tough woman, and he does not argue with one.

trump.note: A friend from the fight nights, though he talks more than he listens.

zelensky.note: A small man holding a big line; he understands that.

greta.note: A young voice that will not be silenced, and he knows how that feels.

monroe.note: The star of a film he watched as a boy, long before any of this.

musk.note: His satellites keep Zelensky's army online, and neither forgets it.

putin.note: The man who invaded his country, and he will not shake his hand for the cameras.

queen.note: A symbol that held a nation together through the worst of its years.

thatcher.note: She told tyrants to their faces, which is what he would like to do.

trump.note: He needs the help and resents the bargaining that comes with it.

tyson.note: A champion who is gentle; there are not many of them.
